title: Russian Rock
description: This project adds a music from Russian Rock
body: Tired of the same old vanilla sound effects in Minecraft? This resource pack will change things up! It replaces the old, boring sounds with Russian rock hits, featuring bands like Agatha Christie, Mumiy Troll, Bi-2, Krematoriy, Amatory, and other equally legendary acts. Some textures have been replaced with posters of these bands. Also, Mikhail Gorshenev will occasionally shout “Hoy” in the caves.![Russian Rock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b877ddb3d7295051a1fd78d46ec44b34062e4127.png)
